history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man in a white Taekwondo uniform with black trim stands on an asphalt road. He has dark, spiky hair and is looking to his right, with his hands clasped in front of him. The uniform has a red triangular emblem on the left shoulder and a dark belt with what appears to be Korean or Chinese characters embroidered in white. In the background, there is a street with red planters filled with green bushes and trees. A blue and white directional sign pointing left is mounted on a pole, alongside a utility pole with numerous electrical wires. Buildings with tiled roofs are visible behind the greenery. The lighting is overcast, creating a soft, diffused light across the scene. The color palette is muted, dominated by grays, whites, greens, and the red of the planters. The overall mood is calm and slightly urban.
